purpose: 原RCR从零重训：多种子、结构/校准消融及单因素参数敏感性；不复算旧模型，不做续训。

data.normalization: reuse archived normal-training-only MinMax input cache
data.cohort: reuse original RCR full-data sample IDs and window references; never repartition by model seed
data.training: all original normal training windows; no 80/20 calibration holdout in this plan
data.validation: original normal validation, checkpoint and threshold only
data.test: original test objects, final metrics only

common_args.scheduler: none, matching original RCR optimizer protocol

scoring.calibration: original normal-only linear conditional mean and log-RMS scale; all train-normal windows
scoring.sigma_clipping: normal-training predicted sigma P5/P95, with min_std floor
scoring.window_to_snippet: top 5 percent mean, ceil, at least one window
scoring.snippet_to_vehicle: Brand3 top 5 percent mean, ceil; CH remains snippet level
scoring.threshold_partition: normal validation, at final evaluation object level
scoring.no_calibration_ablation: same R1 checkpoint; mean(E^2), separately fitted validation P95 threshold

sensitivity.method: one factor at a time, reuse R1 at default; report all values; no test-score winner selection

analysis.seeds: compute Brand3 fivefold mean within each seed, then mean and sample std across three seeds; CH mean/std across seeds
analysis.paired_comparisons: compare R1/R4/R5/R6 on same unit and model seed
analysis.sensitivity: default R1 seed3407 shared across training axes; min_std reuses all 21 full checkpoints
analysis.brand_fault_correlation: same fault vehicles repeat across folds; never treat folds or windows as independent fault vehicles
analysis.historical_results: reference only; do not compare changed-protocol historical checkpoints as paired controls
analysis.external_comparisons: 30-epoch cap fixed; equal cap alone does not prove equality with historical external-model protocols
